20.he: לָ֭כֵן שְׂעִפַּ֣י יְשִׁיב֑וּנִי וּ֝בַעֲב֗וּר ח֣וּשִׁי בִֽי
20.en: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

20.he: מוּסַ֣ר כְּלִמָּתִ֣י אֶשְׁמָ֑ע וְ֝ר֗וּחַ מִֽבִּינָתִ֥י יַעֲנֵֽנִי
20.en: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

20.he: הֲזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתָּ מִנִּי עַ֑ד מִנִּ֤י שִׂ֖ים אָדָ֣ם עֲלֵי אָֽרֶץ
20.en: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

20.he: כִּ֤י רִנְנַ֣ת רְ֭שָׁעִים מִקָּר֑וֹב וְשִׂמְחַ֖ת חָנֵ֣ף עֲדֵי רָֽגַע
20.en: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

20.he: אִם יַעֲלֶ֣ה לַשָּׁמַ֣יִם שִׂיא֑וֹ וְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ לָעָ֥ב יַגִּֽיעַ
20.en: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

20.he: כְּֽ֭גֶלֲלוֹ לָנֶ֣צַח יֹאבֵ֑ד רֹ֝אָ֗יו יֹאמְר֥וּ אַיּֽוֹ
20.en: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

20.he: כַּחֲל֣וֹם יָ֭עוּף וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָא֑וּהוּ וְ֝יֻדַּ֗ד כְּחֶזְי֥וֹן לָֽיְלָה
20.en: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

20.he: עַ֣יִן שְׁ֭זָפַתּוּ וְלֹ֣א תוֹסִ֑יף וְלֹא ע֝֗וֹד תְּשׁוּרֶ֥נּוּ מְקוֹמֽוֹ
20.en: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

20.he: בָּ֭נָיו יְרַצּ֣וּ דַלִּ֑ים וְ֝יָדָ֗יו תָּשֵׁ֥בְנָה אוֹנֽוֹ
20.en: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

20.he: עַ֭צְמוֹתָיו מָלְא֣וּ עלומועלומועֲלוּמָ֑יווְ֝עִמּ֗וֹ עַל עָפָ֥ר תִּשְׁכָּֽב
20.en: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

20.he: אִם תַּמְתִּ֣יק בְּפִ֣יו רָעָ֑ה יַ֝כְחִידֶ֗נָּה תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֽוֹ
20.en: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

20.he: יַחְמֹ֣ל עָ֭לֶיהָ וְלֹ֣א יַֽעַזְבֶ֑נָּה וְ֝יִמְנָעֶ֗נָּה בְּת֣וֹךְ חִכּֽוֹ
20.en: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;

20.he: לַ֭חְמוֹ בְּמֵעָ֣יו נֶהְפָּ֑ךְ מְרוֹרַ֖ת פְּתָנִ֣ים בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ
20.en: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

20.he: חַ֣יִל בָּ֭לַע וַיְקִאֶ֑נּוּ מִ֝בִּטְנ֗וֹ יוֹרִשֶׁ֥נּוּ אֵֽל
20.en: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

20.he: רֹאשׁ פְּתָנִ֥ים יִינָ֑ק תַּֽ֝הַרְגֵ֗הוּ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֶפְעֶֽה
20.en: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

20.he: אַל יֵ֥רֶא בִפְלַגּ֑וֹת נַהֲרֵ֥י נַ֝חֲלֵ֗י דְּבַ֣שׁ וְחֶמְאָֽה
20.en: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

20.he: מֵשִׁ֣יב יָ֭גָע וְלֹ֣א יִבְלָ֑ע כְּחֵ֥יל תְּ֝מוּרָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲלֹֽס
20.en: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

20.he: כִּֽי רִ֭צַּץ עָזַ֣ב דַּלִּ֑ים בַּ֥יִת גָּ֝זַ֗ל וְלֹ֣א יִבֶנֵֽהוּ
20.en: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

20.he: כִּ֤י לֹא יָדַ֣ע שָׁלֵ֣ו בְּבִטְנ֑וֹ בַּ֝חֲמוּד֗וֹ לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּֽט
20.en: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

20.he: אֵין שָׂרִ֥יד לְאָכְל֑וֹ עַל כֵּ֝֗ן לֹא יָחִ֥יל טוּבֽוֹ
20.en: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

20.he: בִּמְלֹ֣אות שִׂ֭פְקוֹ יֵ֣צֶר ל֑וֹ כָּל יַ֖ד עָמֵ֣ל תְּבוֹאֶֽנּוּ
20.en: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

20.he: יְהִ֤י לְמַלֵּ֬א בִטְנ֗וֹ יְֽשַׁלַּח בּ֭וֹ חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ וְיַמְטֵ֥ר עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ בִּלְחוּמֽוֹ
20.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

20.he: יִ֭בְרַח מִנֵּ֣שֶׁק בַּרְזֶ֑ל תַּ֝חְלְפֵ֗הוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת נְחוּשָֽׁה
20.en: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

20.he: שָׁלַף֮ וַיֵּצֵ֪א מִגֵּ֫וָ֥ה וּ֭בָרָק מִֽמְּרֹרָת֥וֹ יַהֲלֹ֗ךְ עָלָ֥יו אֵמִֽים
20.en: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

20.he: כָּל חֹשֶׁךְ֮ טָמ֪וּן לִצְפּ֫וּנָ֥יו תְּ֭אָכְלֵהוּ אֵ֣שׁ לֹֽא נֻפָּ֑ח יֵ֖רַע שָׂרִ֣יד בְּאָהֳלֽוֹ
20.en: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

20.he: יְגַלּ֣וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם עֲוֺנ֑וֹ וְ֝אֶ֗רֶץ מִתְקוֹמָ֘מָ֥ה לֽוֹ
20.en: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

20.he: יִ֭גֶל יְב֣וּל בֵּית֑וֹ נִ֝גָּר֗וֹת בְּי֣וֹם אַפּֽוֹ
20.en: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

20.he: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנַחֲלַ֖ת אִמְר֣וֹ מֵאֵֽל
20.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

21.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר
21.en: Then Job answered,

21.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וּתְהִי זֹ֝֗את תַּנְח֥וּמֹֽתֵיכֶֽם
21.en: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

21.he: שָׂ֭אוּנִי וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְאַחַ֖ר דַּבְּרִ֣י תַלְעִֽיג
21.en: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.

21.he: הֶ֭אָנֹכִי לְאָדָ֣ם שִׂיחִ֑י וְאִם מַ֝דּ֗וּעַ לֹא תִקְצַ֥ר רוּחִֽי
21.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

21.he: פְּנוּ אֵלַ֥י וְהָשַׁ֑מּוּ וְשִׂ֖ימוּ יָ֣ד עַל פֶּֽה
21.en: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

21.he: וְאִם זָכַ֥רְתִּי וְנִבְהָ֑לְתִּי וְאָחַ֥ז בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י פַּלָּצֽוּת
21.en: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

21.he: מַדּ֣וּעַ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִחְי֑וּ עָ֝תְק֗וּ גַּם גָּ֥בְרוּ חָֽיִל
21.en: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

21.he: זַרְעָ֤ם נָכ֣וֹן לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם עִמָּ֑ם וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֗ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם
21.en: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

21.he: בָּתֵּיהֶ֣ם שָׁל֣וֹם מִפָּ֑חַד וְלֹ֤א שֵׁ֖בֶט אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶֽם
21.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

21.he: שׁוֹר֣וֹ עִ֭בַּר וְלֹ֣א יַגְעִ֑ל תְּפַלֵּ֥ט פָּ֝רָת֗וֹ וְלֹ֣א תְשַׁכֵּֽל
21.en: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

21.he: יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ כַ֭צֹּאן עֲוִילֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝יַלְדֵיהֶ֗ם יְרַקֵּדֽוּן
21.en: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

21.he: יִ֭שְׂאוּ כְּתֹ֣ף וְכִנּ֑וֹר וְ֝יִשְׂמְח֗וּ לְק֣וֹל עוּגָֽב
21.en: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

21.he: יבלויבלויְכַלּ֣וּבַטּ֣וֹב יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בְרֶ֗גַע שְׁא֣וֹל יֵחָֽתּוּ
21.en: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

21.he: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְדַ֥עַת דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א חָפָֽצְנוּ
21.en: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

21.he: מַה שַׁדַּ֥י כִּֽי נַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ וּמַה נּ֝וֹעִ֗יל כִּ֣י נִפְגַּע בּֽוֹ
21.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

21.he: הֵ֤ן לֹ֣א בְיָדָ֣ם טוּבָ֑ם עֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי
21.en: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

21.he: כַּמָּ֤ה נֵר רְשָׁ֘עִ֤ים יִדְעָ֗ךְ וְיָבֹ֣א עָלֵ֣ימוֹ אֵידָ֑ם חֲ֝בָלִ֗ים יְחַלֵּ֥ק בְּאַפּֽוֹ
21.en: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

21.he: יִהְי֗וּ כְּתֶ֥בֶן לִפְנֵי ר֑וּחַ וּ֝כְמֹ֗ץ גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה
21.en: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

21.he: אֱל֗וֹהַּ יִצְפֹּן לְבָנָ֥יו אוֹנ֑וֹ יְשַׁלֵּ֖ם אֵלָ֣יו וְיֵדָֽע
21.en: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

21.he: יִרְא֣וּ עינועינועֵינָ֣יוכִּיד֑וֹ וּמֵחֲמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י יִשְׁתֶּֽה
21.en: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

21.he: כִּ֤י מַה חֶפְצ֣וֹ בְּבֵית֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו וּמִסְפַּ֖ר חֳדָשָׁ֣יו חֻצָּֽצוּ
21.en: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

21.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יְלַמֶּד דָּ֑עַת וְ֝ה֗וּא רָמִ֥ים יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
21.en: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

21.he: זֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּעֶ֣צֶם תֻּמּ֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ שַׁלְאֲנַ֥ן וְשָׁלֵֽיו
21.en: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

21.he: עֲ֭טִינָיו מָלְא֣וּ חָלָ֑ב וּמֹ֖חַ עַצְמוֹתָ֣יו יְשֻׁקֶּֽה
21.en: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

21.he: וְזֶ֗ה יָ֭מוּת בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ מָרָ֑ה וְלֹֽא אָ֝כַ֗ל בַּטּוֹבָֽה
21.en: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

21.he: יַ֭חַד עַל עָפָ֣ר יִשְׁכָּ֑בוּ וְ֝רִמָּ֗ה תְּכַסֶּ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם
21.en: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

21.he: הֵ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וּ֝מְזִמּ֗וֹת עָלַ֥י תַּחְמֹֽסוּ
21.en: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

21.he: כִּ֤י תֹֽאמְר֗וּ אַיֵּ֥ה בֵית נָדִ֑יב וְ֝אַיֵּ֗ה אֹ֤הֶל מִשְׁכְּנ֬וֹת רְשָׁעִֽים
21.en: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

21.he: הֲלֹ֣א שְׁ֭אֶלְתֶּם ע֣וֹבְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ וְ֝אֹתֹתָ֗ם לֹ֣א תְנַכֵּֽרוּ
21.en: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

21.he: כִּ֤י לְי֣וֹם אֵ֭יד יֵחָ֣שֶׂךְ רָ֑ע לְי֖וֹם עֲבָר֣וֹת יוּבָֽלוּ
21.en: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?

21.he: מִֽי יַגִּ֣יד עַל פָּנָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְהֽוּא עָ֝שָׂ֗ה מִ֣י יְשַׁלֶּם לֽוֹ
21.en: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

21.he: וְ֭הוּא לִקְבָר֣וֹת יוּבָ֑ל וְֽעַל גָּדִ֥ישׁ יִשְׁקֽוֹד
21.en: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

21.he: מָֽתְקוּ ל֗וֹ רִגְבֵ֫י נָ֥חַל וְ֭אַחֲרָיו כָּל אָדָ֣ם יִמְשׁ֑וֹךְ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר
21.en: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

21.he: וְ֭אֵיךְ תְּנַחֲמ֣וּנִי הָ֑בֶל וּ֝תְשֽׁוּבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם נִשְׁאַר מָֽעַל
21.en: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

22.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּמָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר
22.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

22.he: הַלְאֵ֥ל יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר כִּֽי יִסְכֹּ֖ן עָלֵ֣ימוֹ מַשְׂכִּֽיל
22.en: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

22.he: הַחֵ֣פֶץ לְ֭שַׁדַּי כִּ֣י תִצְדָּ֑ק וְאִם בֶּ֝֗צַע כִּֽי תַתֵּ֥ם דְּרָכֶֽיךָ
22.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

22.he: הֲֽ֭מִיִּרְאָ֣תְךָ יֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ יָב֥וֹא עִ֝מְּךָ֗ בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
22.en: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

22.he: הֲלֹ֣א רָעָֽתְךָ֣ רַבָּ֑ה וְאֵֽין קֵ֝֗ץ לַעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ
22.en: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

22.he: כִּֽי תַחְבֹּ֣ל אַחֶ֣יךָ חִנָּ֑ם וּבִגְדֵ֖י עֲרוּמִּ֣ים תַּפְשִֽׁיט
22.en: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

22.he: לֹא מַ֭יִם עָיֵ֣ף תַּשְׁקֶ֑ה וּ֝מֵרָעֵ֗ב תִּֽמְנַֽע לָֽחֶם
22.en: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

22.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ זְ֭רוֹעַ ל֣וֹ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּנְשׂ֥וּא פָ֝נִ֗ים יֵ֣שֶׁב בָּֽהּ
22.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

22.he: אַ֭לְמָנוֹת שִׁלַּ֣חְתָּ רֵיקָ֑ם וּזְרֹע֖וֹת יְתֹמִ֣ים יְדֻכָּֽא
22.en: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

22.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן סְבִיבוֹתֶ֣יךָ פַחִ֑ים וִֽ֝יבַהֶלְךָ פַּ֣חַד פִּתְאֹֽם
22.en: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

22.he: אוֹ חֹ֥שֶׁךְ לֹֽא תִרְאֶ֑ה וְֽשִׁפְעַת מַ֥יִם תְּכַסֶּֽךָּ
22.en: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

22.he: הֲֽלֹא אֱ֭לוֹהַּ גֹּ֣בַהּ שָׁמָ֑יִם וּרְאֵ֤ה רֹ֖אשׁ כּוֹכָבִ֣ים כִּי רָֽמּוּ
22.en: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

22.he: וְֽ֭אָמַרְתָּ מַה יָּ֣דַֽע אֵ֑ל הַבְעַ֖ד עֲרָפֶ֣ל יִשְׁפּֽוֹט
22.en: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

22.he: עָבִ֣ים סֵֽתֶר ל֭וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וְח֥וּג שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יִתְהַלָּֽךְ
22.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

22.he: הַאֹ֣רַח עוֹלָ֣ם תִּשְׁמֹ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר דָּרְכ֣וּ מְתֵי אָֽוֶן
22.en: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

22.he: אֲשֶֽׁר קֻמְּט֥וּ וְלֹא עֵ֑ת נָ֝הָ֗ר יוּצַ֥ק יְסוֹדָֽם
22.en: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

22.he: הָאֹמְרִ֣ים לָ֭אֵל ס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּמַה יִּפְעַ֖ל שַׁדַּ֣י לָֽמוֹ
22.en: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

22.he: וְה֤וּא מִלֵּ֣א בָתֵּיהֶ֣ם ט֑וֹב וַעֲצַ֥ת רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים רָ֣חֲקָה מֶֽנִּי
22.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

22.he: יִרְא֣וּ צַדִּיקִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְ֝נָקִ֗י יִלְעַג לָֽמוֹ
22.en: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

22.he: אִם לֹ֣א נִכְחַ֣ד קִימָ֑נוּ וְ֝יִתְרָ֗ם אָ֣כְלָה אֵֽשׁ
22.en: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

22.he: הַסְכֶּן נָ֣א עִמּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלם בָּ֝הֶ֗ם תְּֽבוֹאַתְךָ֥ טוֹבָֽה
22.en: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

22.he: קַח נָ֣א מִפִּ֣יו תּוֹרָ֑ה וְשִׂ֥ים אֲ֝מָרָ֗יו בִּלְבָבֶֽךָ
22.en: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

22.he: אִם תָּשׁ֣וּב עַד שַׁ֭דַּי תִּבָּנֶ֑ה תַּרְחִ֥יק עַ֝וְלָ֗ה מֵאָהֳלֶֽךָ
22.en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

22.he: וְשִׁית עַל עָפָ֥ר בָּ֑צֶר וּבְצ֖וּר נְחָלִ֣ים אוֹפִֽיר
22.en: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

22.he: וְהָיָ֣ה שַׁדַּ֣י בְּצָרֶ֑יךָ וְכֶ֖סֶף תּוֹעָפ֣וֹת לָֽךְ
22.en: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

22.he: כִּי אָ֭ז עַל שַׁדַּ֣י תִּתְעַנָּ֑ג וְתִשָּׂ֖א אֶל אֱל֣וֹהַּ פָּנֶֽיךָ
22.en: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

22.he: תַּעְתִּ֣יר אֵ֭לָיו וְיִשְׁמָעֶ֑ךָּ וּנְדָרֶ֥יךָ תְשַׁלֵּֽם
22.en: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

22.he: וְֽתִגְזַר א֭וֹמֶר וְיָ֣קָם לָ֑ךְ וְעַל דְּ֝רָכֶ֗יךָ נָ֣גַֽהּ אֽוֹר
22.en: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

22.he: כִּֽי הִ֭שְׁפִּילוּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּוָ֑ה וְשַׁ֖ח עֵינַ֣יִם יוֹשִֽׁעַ
22.en: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

22.he: יְֽמַלֵּ֥ט אִֽי נָקִ֑י וְ֝נִמְלַ֗ט בְּבֹ֣ר כַּפֶּֽיךָ
22.en: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

23.he: גַּם הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל אַנְחָתִֽי
23.en: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

23.he: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ
23.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

23.he: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת
23.en: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

23.he: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי
23.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

23.he: הַבְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי
23.en: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

23.he: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי
23.en: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

23.he: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ
23.en: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;

23.he: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה
23.en: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

23.he: כִּֽי יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא
23.en: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

23.he: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא אָֽט
23.en: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

23.he: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי פִֽיו
23.en: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

23.he: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ
23.en: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

23.he: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ
23.en: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

23.he: עַל כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ
23.en: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

23.he: כִּֽי לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י כִּסָּה אֹֽפֶל
23.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

24.he: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וידעווידעווְ֝יֹדְעָ֗יולֹא חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו
24.en: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

24.he: גְּבֻל֥וֹת יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ עֵ֥דֶר גָּ֝זְל֗וּ וַיִּרְעֽוּ
24.en: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

24.he: חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים יִנְהָ֑גוּ יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ שׁ֣וֹר אַלְמָנָֽה
24.en: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

24.he: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ עֲנִיֵּי אָֽרֶץ
24.en: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

24.he: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים בַּֽמִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים
24.en: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

24.he: בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה בְּלִיל֣וֹ יקצירויקצירויִקְצ֑וֹרוּוְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ
24.en: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

24.he: עָר֣וֹם יָ֭לִינוּ מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה
24.en: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

24.he: מִזֶּ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים יִרְטָ֑בוּ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה חִבְּקוּ צֽוּר
24.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

24.he: יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד יָת֑וֹם וְֽעַל עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ
24.en: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

24.he: עָר֣וֹם הִ֭לְּכוּ בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר
24.en: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

24.he: בֵּין שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם יַצְהִ֑ירוּ יְקָבִ֥ים דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ
24.en: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

24.he: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ לֹא יָשִׂ֥ים תִּפְלָֽה
24.en: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

24.he: הֵ֤מָּה הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י א֥וֹר לֹֽא הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו
24.en: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

24.he: לָא֡וֹר יָ֘ק֤וּם רוֹצֵ֗חַ יִֽקְטָל עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב
24.en: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

24.he: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי עָ֑יִן וְסֵ֖תֶר פָּנִ֣ים יָשִֽׂים
24.en: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

24.he: חָתַ֥ר בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ לָ֗מוֹ לֹא יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר
24.en: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

24.he: כִּ֤י יַחְדָּ֨ו בֹּ֣קֶר לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת כִּֽי יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת
24.en: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

24.he: קַֽל ה֤וּא עַל פְּנֵי מַ֗יִם תְּקֻלַּ֣ל חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים
24.en: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

24.he: צִיָּ֤ה גַם חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ
24.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

24.he: יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רֶ֨חֶם מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ רִמָּ֗ה ע֥וֹד לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֑ר וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ עַוְלָֽה
24.en: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

24.he: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב
24.en: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

24.he: וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים בְּכֹח֑וֹ יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין
24.en: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

24.he: יִתֶּן ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם
24.en: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

24.he: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ כַּכֹּ֥ל יִקָּפְצ֑וּן וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת יִמָּֽלוּ
24.en: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

24.he: וְאִם לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְ֝אַ֗ל מִלָּתִֽי
24.en: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

25.he: הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו
25.en: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

25.he: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל מִ֝֗י לֹא יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ
25.en: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

25.he: וּמַה יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם אֵ֑ל וּמַה יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה
25.en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

25.he: הֵ֣ן עַד יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו
25.en: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

25.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה
25.en: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”

26.he: מֶה עָזַ֥רְתָּ לְלֹא כֹ֑חַ ה֝וֹשַׁ֗עְתָּ זְר֣וֹעַ לֹא עֹֽז
26.en: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

26.he: מַה יָּ֭עַצְתָּ לְלֹ֣א חָכְמָ֑ה וְ֝תוּשִׁיָּ֗ה לָרֹ֥ב הוֹדָֽעְתָּ
26.en: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

26.he: אֶת מִ֭י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ מִלִּ֑ין וְנִשְׁמַת מִ֝י יָצְאָ֥ה מִמֶּֽךָּ
26.en: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?
“The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

26.he: עָר֣וֹם שְׁא֣וֹל נֶגְדּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָֽאֲבַדּֽוֹן
26.en: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

26.he: נֹטֶ֣ה צָפ֣וֹן עַל תֹּ֑הוּ תֹּ֥לֶה אֶ֝֗רֶץ עַל בְּלִי מָֽה
26.en: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

26.he: צֹרֵֽר מַ֥יִם בְּעָבָ֑יו וְלֹא נִבְקַ֖ע עָנָ֣ן תַּחְתָּֽם
26.en: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

26.he: מְאַחֵ֥ז פְּנֵי כִסֵּ֑ה פַּרְשֵׁ֖ז עָלָ֣יו עֲנָנֽוֹ
26.en: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

26.he: חֹֽק חָ֭ג עַל פְּנֵי מָ֑יִם עַד תַּכְלִ֖ית א֣וֹר עִם חֹֽשֶׁךְ
26.en: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.
He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

26.he: בְּ֭רוּחוֹ שָׁמַ֣יִם שִׁפְרָ֑ה חֹֽלֲלָ֥ה יָ֝ד֗וֹ נָחָ֥שׁ בָּרִֽיחַ
26.en: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

26.he: הֶן אֵ֤לֶּה קְצ֬וֹת דרכודרכודְּרָכָ֗יווּמַה שֵּׁ֣מֶץ דָּ֭בָר נִשְׁמַע בּ֑וֹ וְרַ֥עַם גבורתוגבורתוגְּ֝בוּרוֹתָ֗יומִ֣י יִתְבּוֹנָֽן
26.en: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

27.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר
27.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,

27.he: חַי אֵ֭ל הֵסִ֣יר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י הֵמַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁי
27.en: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

27.he: כִּֽי כָל ע֣וֹד נִשְׁמָתִ֣י בִ֑י וְר֖וּחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּאַפִּֽי
27.en: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

27.he: אִם תְּדַבֵּ֣רְנָה שְׂפָתַ֣י עַוְלָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנִ֗י אִם יֶהְגֶּ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה
27.en: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

27.he: חָלִ֣ילָה לִּי֮ אִם אַצְדִּ֪יק אֶ֫תְכֶ֥ם עַד אֶגְוָ֑ע לֹא אָסִ֖יר תֻּמָּתִ֣י מִמֶּֽנִּי
27.en: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

27.he: בְּצִדְקָתִ֣י הֶ֭חֱזַקְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֑הָ לֹֽא יֶחֱרַ֥ף לְ֝בָבִ֗י מִיָּמָֽי
27.en: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

27.he: יְהִ֣י כְ֭רָשָׁע אֹ֣יְבִ֑י וּמִתְקוֹמְמִ֥י כְעַוָּֽל
27.en: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

27.he: כִּ֤י מַה תִּקְוַ֣ת חָ֭נֵף כִּ֣י יִבְצָ֑ע כִּ֤י יֵ֖שֶׁל אֱל֣וֹהַּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ
27.en: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

27.he: הַֽ֭צַעֲקָתוֹ יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל כִּֽי תָב֖וֹא עָלָ֣יו צָרָֽה
27.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

27.he: אִם עַל שַׁדַּ֥י יִתְעַנָּ֑ג יִקְרָ֖א אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּכָל עֵֽת
27.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

27.he: אוֹרֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֣ם בְּיַד אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִם שַׁ֝דַּ֗י לֹ֣א אֲכַחֵֽד
27.en: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

27.he: הֵן אַתֶּ֣ם כֻּלְּכֶ֣ם חֲזִיתֶ֑ם וְלָמָּה זֶּ֝֗ה הֶ֣בֶל תֶּהְבָּֽלוּ
27.en: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

27.he: זֶ֤ה חֵֽלֶק אָדָ֖ם רָשָׁ֥ע עִם אֵ֑ל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת עָ֝רִיצִ֗ים מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יִקָּֽחוּ
27.en: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

27.he: אִם יִרְבּ֣וּ בָנָ֣יו לְמוֹ חָ֑רֶב וְ֝צֶאֱצָאָ֗יו לֹ֣א יִשְׂבְּעוּ לָֽחֶם
27.en: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

27.he: שרידושרידושְׂ֭רִידָיובַּמָּ֣וֶת יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה
27.en: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

27.he: אִם יִצְבֹּ֣ר כֶּעָפָ֣ר כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝כַחֹ֗מֶר יָכִ֥ין מַלְבּֽוּשׁ
27.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

27.he: יָ֭כִין וְצַדִּ֣יק יִלְבָּ֑שׁ וְ֝כֶ֗סֶף נָקִ֥י יַחֲלֹֽק
27.en: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

27.he: בָּנָ֣ה כָעָ֣שׁ בֵּית֑וֹ וּ֝כְסֻכָּ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה נֹצֵֽר
27.en: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

27.he: עָשִׁ֣יר יִ֭שְׁכַּב וְלֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף עֵינָ֖יו פָּקַ֣ח וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ
27.en: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

27.he: תַּשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ כַ֭מַּיִם בַּלָּה֑וֹת לַ֝֗יְלָה גְּנָבַ֥תּוּ סוּפָֽה
27.en: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

27.he: יִשָּׂאֵ֣הוּ קָדִ֣ים וְיֵלַ֑ךְ וִֽ֝ישָׂעֲרֵ֗הוּ מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
27.en: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

27.he: וְיַשְׁלֵ֣ךְ עָ֭לָיו וְלֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל מִ֝יָּד֗וֹ בָּר֥וֹחַ יִבְרָֽח
27.en: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

27.he: יִשְׂפֹּ֣ק עָלֵ֣ימוֹ כַפֵּ֑ימוֹ וְיִשְׁרֹ֥ק עָ֝לָ֗יו מִמְּקֹמֽוֹ
27.en: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

28.he: כִּ֤י יֵ֣שׁ לַכֶּ֣סֶף מוֹצָ֑א וּ֝מָק֗וֹם לַזָּהָ֥ב יָזֹֽקּוּ
28.en: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

28.he: בַּ֭רְזֶל מֵעָפָ֣ר יֻקָּ֑ח וְ֝אֶ֗בֶן יָצ֥וּק נְחוּשָֽׁה
28.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

28.he: קֵ֤ץ שָׂ֤ם לַחֹ֗שֶׁךְ וּֽלְכָל תַּ֭כְלִית ה֣וּא חוֹקֵ֑ר אֶ֖בֶן אֹ֣פֶל וְצַלְמָֽוֶת
28.en: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

28.he: פָּ֤רַץ נַ֨חַל מֵֽעִם גָּ֗ר הַֽנִּשְׁכָּחִ֥ים מִנִּי רָ֑גֶל דַּ֖לּוּ מֵאֱנ֣וֹשׁ נָֽעוּ
28.en: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

28.he: אֶ֗רֶץ מִמֶּ֥נָּה יֵֽצֵא לָ֑חֶם וְ֝תַחְתֶּ֗יהָ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ כְּמוֹ אֵֽשׁ
28.en: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

28.he: מְקוֹם סַפִּ֥יר אֲבָנֶ֑יהָ וְעַפְרֹ֖ת זָהָ֣ב לֽוֹ
28.en: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

28.he: נָ֭תִיב לֹֽא יְדָ֣עוֹ עָ֑יִט וְלֹ֥א שְׁ֝זָפַ֗תּוּ עֵ֣ין אַיָּֽה
28.en: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

28.he: לֹֽא הִדְרִיכֻ֥הוּ בְנֵי שָׁ֑חַץ לֹֽא עָדָ֖ה עָלָ֣יו שָֽׁחַל
28.en: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

28.he: בַּֽ֭חַלָּמִישׁ שָׁלַ֣ח יָד֑וֹ הָפַ֖ךְ מִשֹּׁ֣רֶשׁ הָרִֽים
28.en: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

28.he: בַּ֭צּוּרוֹת יְאֹרִ֣ים בִּקֵּ֑עַ וְכָל יְ֝קָ֗ר רָאֲתָ֥ה עֵינֽוֹ
28.en: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

28.he: מִ֭בְּכִי נְהָר֣וֹת חִבֵּ֑שׁ וְ֝תַעֲלֻמָ֗הּ יֹ֣צִא אֽוֹר
28.en: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

28.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תִּמָּצֵ֑א וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
28.en: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

28.he: לֹא יָדַ֣ע אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עֶרְכָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תִ֝מָּצֵ֗א בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּֽים
28.en: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

28.he: תְּה֣וֹם אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א בִי הִ֑יא וְיָ֥ם אָ֝מַ֗ר אֵ֣ין עִמָּדִֽי
28.en: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

28.he: לֹא יֻתַּ֣ן סְג֣וֹר תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְלֹ֥א יִ֝שָּׁקֵ֗ל כֶּ֣סֶף מְחִירָֽהּ
28.en: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

28.he: לֹֽא תְ֭סֻלֶּה בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִ֑יר בְּשֹׁ֖הַם יָקָ֣ר וְסַפִּֽיר
28.en: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

28.he: לֹא יַעַרְכֶ֣נָּה זָ֭הָב וּזְכוֹכִ֑ית וּתְמ֖וּרָתָ֣הּ כְּלִי פָֽז
28.en: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

28.he: רָאמ֣וֹת וְ֭גָבִישׁ לֹ֣א יִזָּכֵ֑ר וּמֶ֥שֶׁךְ חָ֝כְמָ֗ה מִפְּנִינִֽים
28.en: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

28.he: לֹֽא יַ֭עַרְכֶנָּה פִּטְדַת כּ֑וּשׁ בְּכֶ֥תֶם טָ֝ה֗וֹר לֹ֣א תְסֻלֶּֽה
28.en: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it, nor will it be valued with pure gold.

28.he: וְֽ֭הַחָכְמָה מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא וְאֵ֥י זֶ֝֗ה מְק֣וֹם בִּינָֽה
28.en: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

28.he: וְֽ֭נֶעֶלְמָה מֵעֵינֵ֣י כָל חָ֑י וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם נִסְתָּֽרָה
28.en: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

28.he: אֲבַדּ֣וֹן וָ֭מָוֶת אָ֣מְר֑וּ בְּ֝אָזְנֵ֗ינוּ שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ שִׁמְעָֽהּ
28.en: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

28.he: אֱ֭לֹהִים הֵבִ֣ין דַּרְכָּ֑הּ וְ֝ה֗וּא יָדַ֥ע אֶת מְקוֹמָֽהּ
28.en: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

28.he: כִּי ה֭וּא לִקְצוֹת הָאָ֣רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִרְאֶֽה
28.en: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

28.he: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָר֣וּחַ מִשְׁקָ֑ל וּ֝מַ֗יִם תִּכֵּ֥ן בְּמִדָּֽה
28.en: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

28.he: בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ לַמָּטָ֣ר חֹ֑ק וְ֝דֶ֗רֶךְ לַחֲזִ֥יז קֹלֽוֹת
28.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

28.he: אָ֣ז רָ֭אָהּ וַֽיְסַפְּרָ֑הּ הֱ֝כִינָ֗הּ וְגַם חֲקָרָֽהּ
28.en: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

28.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָֽאָדָ֗ם הֵ֤ן יִרְאַ֣ת אֲ֭דֹנָי הִ֣יא חָכְמָ֑ה וְס֖וּר מֵרָ֣ע בִּינָֽה
28.en: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”

29.he: וַיֹּ֣סֶף אִ֭יּוֹב שְׂאֵ֥ת מְשָׁל֗וֹ וַיֹּאמַֽר
29.en: Job again took up his parable, and said,

29.he: מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֥נִי כְיַרְחֵי קֶ֑דֶם כִּ֝ימֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יִשְׁמְרֵֽנִי
29.en: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

29.he: בְּהִלּ֣וֹ נֵ֭רוֹ עֲלֵ֣י רֹאשִׁ֑י לְ֝אוֹרוֹ אֵ֣לֶךְ חֹֽשֶׁךְ
29.en: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

29.he: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הָ֭יִיתִי בִּימֵ֣י חָרְפִּ֑י בְּס֥וֹד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ עֲלֵ֣י אָהֳלִֽי
29.en: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

29.he: בְּע֣וֹד שַׁ֭דַּי עִמָּדִ֑י סְבִ֖יבוֹתַ֣י נְעָרָֽי
29.en: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

29.he: בִּרְחֹ֣ץ הֲלִיכַ֣י בְּחֵמָ֑ה וְצ֥וּר יָצ֥וּק עִ֝מָּדִ֗י פַּלְגֵי שָֽׁמֶן
29.en: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

29.he: בְּצֵ֣אתִי שַׁ֣עַר עֲלֵי קָ֑רֶת בָּ֝רְח֗וֹב אָכִ֥ין מוֹשָׁבִֽי
29.en: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

29.he: רָא֣וּנִי נְעָרִ֣ים וְנֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וִֽ֝ישִׁישִׁים קָ֣מוּ עָמָֽדוּ
29.en: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

29.he: שָׂ֭רִים עָצְר֣וּ בְמִלִּ֑ים וְ֝כַ֗ף יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לְפִיהֶֽם
29.en: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

29.he: קוֹל נְגִידִ֥ים נֶחְבָּ֑אוּ וּ֝לְשׁוֹנָ֗ם לְחִכָּ֥ם דָּבֵֽקָה
29.en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

29.he: כִּ֤י אֹ֣זֶן שָׁ֭מְעָה וַֽתְּאַשְּׁרֵ֑נִי וְעַ֥יִן רָ֝אֲתָ֗ה וַתְּעִידֵֽנִי
29.en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

29.he: כִּֽי אֲ֭מַלֵּט עָנִ֣י מְשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וְ֝יָת֗וֹם וְֽלֹא עֹזֵ֥ר לֽוֹ
29.en: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

29.he: בִּרְכַּ֣ת אֹ֭בֵד עָלַ֣י תָּבֹ֑א וְלֵ֖ב אַלְמָנָ֣ה אַרְנִֽן
29.en: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

29.he: צֶ֣דֶק לָ֭בַשְׁתִּי וַיִּלְבָּשֵׁ֑נִי כִּֽמְעִ֥יל וְ֝צָנִ֗יף מִשְׁפָּטִֽי
29.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

29.he: עֵינַ֣יִם הָ֭יִיתִי לַֽעִוֵּ֑ר וְרַגְלַ֖יִם לַפִּסֵּ֣חַ אָֽנִי
29.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

29.he: אָ֣ב אָ֭נֹכִֽי לָֽאֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים וְרִ֖ב לֹא יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶחְקְרֵֽהוּ
29.en: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him who I didn’t know.

29.he: וָֽ֭אֲשַׁבְּרָה מְתַלְּע֣וֹת עַוָּ֑ל וּ֝מִשִּׁנָּ֗יו אַשְׁלִ֥יךְ טָֽרֶף
29.en: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

29.he: וָ֭אֹמַר עִם קִנִּ֣י אֶגְוָ֑ע וְ֝כַח֗וֹל אַרְבֶּ֥ה יָמִֽים
29.en: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

29.he: שָׁרְשִׁ֣י פָת֣וּחַ אֱלֵי מָ֑יִם וְ֝טַ֗ל יָלִ֥ין בִּקְצִירִֽי
29.en: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

29.he: כְּ֭בוֹדִי חָדָ֣שׁ עִמָּדִ֑י וְ֝קַשְׁתִּ֗י בְּיָדִ֥י תַחֲלִֽיף
29.en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

29.he: לִֽי שָׁמְע֥וּ וְיִחֵ֑לּוּ וְ֝יִדְּמ֗וּ לְמ֣וֹ עֲצָתִֽי
29.en: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

29.he: אַחֲרֵ֣י דְ֭בָרִי לֹ֣א יִשְׁנ֑וּ וְ֝עָלֵ֗ימוֹ תִּטֹּ֥ף מִלָּתִֽי
29.en: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

29.he: וְיִֽחֲל֣וּ כַמָּטָ֣ר לִ֑י וּ֝פִיהֶ֗ם פָּעֲר֥וּ לְמַלְקֽוֹשׁ
29.en: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

29.he: אֶשְׂחַ֣ק אֲ֭לֵהֶם לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ינוּ וְא֥וֹר פָּ֝נַ֗י לֹ֣א יַפִּילֽוּן
29.en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

29.he: אֶֽבֲחַ֣ר דַּרְכָּם֮ וְאֵשֵׁ֪ב רֹ֥אשׁ וְ֭אֶשְׁכּוֹן כְּמֶ֣לֶךְ בַּגְּד֑וּד כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבֵלִ֣ים יְנַחֵֽם
29.en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

30.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה שָֽׂחֲק֣וּ עָלַי֮ צְעִירִ֥ים מִמֶּ֗נִּי לְיָ֫מִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר מָאַ֥סְתִּי אֲבוֹתָ֑ם לָ֝שִׁ֗ית עִם כַּלְבֵ֥י צֹאנִֽי
30.en: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

30.he: גַּם כֹּ֣חַ יְ֭דֵיהֶם לָ֣מָּה לִּ֑י עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ אָ֣בַד כָּֽלַח
30.en: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

30.he: בְּחֶ֥סֶר וּבְכָפָ֗ן גַּ֫לְמ֥וּד הַֽעֹרְקִ֥ים צִיָּ֑ה אֶ֝֗מֶשׁ שׁוֹאָ֥ה וּמְשֹׁאָֽה
30.en: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

30.he: הַקֹּטְפִ֣ים מַלּ֣וּחַ עֲלֵי שִׂ֑יחַ וְשֹׁ֖רֶשׁ רְתָמִ֣ים לַחְמָֽם
30.en: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

30.he: מִן גֵּ֥ו יְגֹרָ֑שׁוּ יָרִ֥יעוּ עָ֝לֵ֗ימוֹ כַּגַּנָּֽב
30.en: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief;

30.he: בַּעֲר֣וּץ נְחָלִ֣ים לִשְׁכֹּ֑ן חֹרֵ֖י עָפָ֣ר וְכֵפִֽים
30.en: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

30.he: בֵּין שִׂיחִ֥ים יִנְהָ֑קוּ תַּ֖חַת חָר֣וּל יְסֻפָּֽחוּ
30.en: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles .

30.he: בְּֽנֵי נָ֭בָל גַּם בְּנֵ֣י בְלִי שֵׁ֑ם נִ֝כְּא֗וּ מִן הָאָֽרֶץ
30.en: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

30.he: וְ֭עַתָּה נְגִינָתָ֣ם הָיִ֑יתִי וָאֱהִ֖י לָהֶ֣ם לְמִלָּֽה
30.en: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

30.he: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי רָ֣חֲקוּ מֶ֑נִּי וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י לֹא חָ֥שְׂכוּ רֹֽק
30.en: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

30.he: כִּֽי יתרויתרויִתְרִ֣יפִ֭תַּח וַיְעַנֵּ֑נִי וְ֝רֶ֗סֶן מִפָּנַ֥י שִׁלֵּֽחוּ
30.en: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

30.he: עַל יָמִין֮ פִּרְחַ֪ח יָ֫ק֥וּמוּ רַגְלַ֥י שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ וַיָּסֹ֥לּוּ עָ֝לַ֗י אָרְח֥וֹת אֵידָֽם
30.en: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

30.he: נָתְס֗וּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י לְהַוָּתִ֥י יֹעִ֑ילוּ לֹ֖א עֹזֵ֣ר לָֽמוֹ
30.en: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

30.he: כְּפֶ֣רֶץ רָחָ֣ב יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ תַּ֥חַת שֹׁ֝אָ֗ה הִתְגַּלְגָּֽלוּ
30.en: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

30.he: הָהְפַּ֥ךְ עָלַ֗י בַּלָּ֫ה֥וֹת תִּרְדֹּ֣ף כָּ֭רוּחַ נְדִבָתִ֑י וּ֝כְעָ֗ב עָבְרָ֥ה יְשֻׁעָתִֽי
30.en: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

30.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה עָ֭לַי תִּשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ נַפְשִׁ֑י יֹ֭אחֲז֣וּנִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
30.en: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

30.he: לַ֗יְלָה עֲ֭צָמַי נִקַּ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְ֝עֹרְקַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁכָּבֽוּן
30.en: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

30.he: בְּרָב כֹּ֭חַ יִתְחַפֵּ֣שׂ לְבוּשִׁ֑י כְּפִ֖י כֻתָּנְתִּ֣י יַֽאַזְרֵֽנִי
30.en: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

30.he: הֹרָ֥נִי לַחֹ֑מֶר וָ֝אֶתְמַשֵּׁ֗ל כֶּעָפָ֥ר וָאֵֽפֶר
30.en: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

30.he: אֲשַׁוַּ֣ע אֵ֭לֶיךָ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֵ֑נִי עָ֝מַ֗דְתִּי וַתִּתְבֹּ֥נֶן בִּֽי
30.en: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

30.he: תֵּהָפֵ֣ךְ לְאַכְזָ֣ר לִ֑י בְּעֹ֖צֶם יָדְךָ֣ תִשְׂטְמֵֽנִי
30.en: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

30.he: תִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי אֶל ר֭וּחַ תַּרְכִּיבֵ֑נִי וּ֝תְמֹגְגֵ֗נִי תשוהתשוהתּוּשִׁיָּֽה
30.en: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

30.he: כִּֽי יָ֭דַעְתִּי מָ֣וֶת תְּשִׁיבֵ֑נִי וּבֵ֖ית מוֹעֵ֣ד לְכָל חָֽי
30.en: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.

30.he: אַ֣ךְ לֹא בְ֭עִי יִשְׁלַח יָ֑ד אִם בְּ֝פִיד֗וֹ לָהֶ֥ן שֽׁוּעַ
30.en: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

30.he: אִם לֹ֣א בָ֭כִיתִי לִקְשֵׁה י֑וֹם עָֽגְמָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י לָאֶבְיֽוֹן
30.en: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

30.he: כִּ֤י ט֣וֹב קִ֭וִּיתִי וַיָּ֣בֹא רָ֑ע וַֽאֲיַחֲלָ֥ה לְ֝א֗וֹר וַיָּ֥בֹא אֹֽפֶל
30.en: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

30.he: מֵעַ֖י רֻתְּח֥וּ וְלֹא דָ֗מּוּ קִדְּמֻ֥נִי יְמֵי עֹֽנִי
30.en: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

30.he: קֹדֵ֣ר הִ֭לַּכְתִּי בְּלֹ֣א חַמָּ֑ה קַ֖מְתִּי בַקָּהָ֣ל אֲשַׁוֵּֽעַ
30.en: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

30.he: אָ֭ח הָיִ֣יתִי לְתַנִּ֑ים וְ֝רֵ֗עַ לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה
30.en: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

30.he: ע֭וֹרִי שָׁחַ֣ר מֵעָלָ֑י וְעַצְמִי חָ֝֗רָה מִנִּי חֹֽרֶב
30.en: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

30.he: וַיְהִ֣י לְ֭אֵבֶל כִּנֹּרִ֑י וְ֝עֻגָבִ֗י לְק֣וֹל בֹּכִֽים
30.en: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

31.he: בְּ֭רִית כָּרַ֣תִּי לְעֵינָ֑י וּמָ֥ה אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן עַל בְּתוּלָֽה
31.en: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

31.he: וּמֶ֤ה חֵ֣לֶק אֱל֣וֹהַּ מִמָּ֑עַל וְֽנַחֲלַ֥ת שַׁ֝דַּ֗י מִמְּרֹמִֽים
31.en: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

31.he: הֲלֹא אֵ֥יד לְעַוָּ֑ל וְ֝נֵ֗כֶר לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
31.en: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

31.he: הֲלֹא ה֭וּא יִרְאֶ֣ה דְרָכָ֑י וְֽכָל צְעָדַ֥י יִסְפּֽוֹר
31.en: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

31.he: אִם הָלַ֥כְתִּי עִם שָׁ֑וְא וַתַּ֖חַשׁ עַל מִרְמָ֣ה רַגְלִֽי
31.en: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

31.he: יִשְׁקְלֵ֥נִי בְמֹאזְנֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְיֵדַ֥ע אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ תֻּמָּתִֽי
31.en: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

31.he: אִ֥ם תִּטֶּ֣ה אַשֻּׁרִי֮ מִנִּ֪י הַ֫דָּ֥רֶךְ וְאַחַ֣ר עֵ֭ינַי הָלַ֣ךְ לִבִּ֑י וּ֝בְכַפַּ֗י דָּ֣בַק מֻאֽוּם
31.en: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

31.he: אֶ֭זְרְעָה וְאַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל וְֽצֶאֱצָאַ֥י יְשֹׁרָֽשׁוּ
31.en: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

31.he: אִם נִפְתָּ֣ה לִ֭בִּי עַל אִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַל פֶּ֖תַח רֵעִ֣י אָרָֽבְתִּי
31.en: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

31.he: תִּטְחַ֣ן לְאַחֵ֣ר אִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ יִכְרְע֥וּן אֲחֵרִֽין
31.en: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

31.he: כִּי הואהואהִ֥יאזִמָּ֑ה והיאוהיאוְ֝ה֗וּאעָוֺ֥ן פְּלִילִֽים
31.en: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges;

31.he: כִּ֤י אֵ֣שׁ הִ֭יא עַד אֲבַדּ֣וֹן תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּֽבְכָל תְּב֖וּאָתִ֣י תְשָׁרֵֽשׁ
31.en: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

31.he: אִם אֶמְאַ֗ס מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַ֭בְדִּי וַאֲמָתִ֑י בְּ֝רִבָ֗ם עִמָּדִֽי
31.en: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

31.he: וּמָ֣ה אֶֽ֭עֱשֶׂה כִּֽי יָק֣וּם אֵ֑ל וְכִֽי יִ֝פְקֹ֗ד מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ
31.en: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

31.he: הֲֽ֝לֹא בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד
31.en: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

31.he: אִם אֶ֭מְנַע מֵחֵ֣פֶץ דַּלִּ֑ים וְעֵינֵ֖י אַלְמָנָ֣ה אֲכַלֶּֽה
31.en: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

31.he: וְאֹכַ֣ל פִּתִּ֣י לְבַדִּ֑י וְלֹא אָכַ֖ל יָת֣וֹם מִמֶּֽנָּה
31.en: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

31.he: כִּ֣י מִ֭נְּעוּרַי גְּדֵלַ֣נִי כְאָ֑ב וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן אִמִּ֣י אַנְחֶֽנָּה
31.en: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

31.he: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֭וֹבֵד מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת לָאֶבְיֽוֹן
31.en: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

31.he: אִם לֹ֣א בֵרֲכ֣וּנִי חלצוחלצוחֲלָצָ֑יווּמִגֵּ֥ז כְּ֝בָשַׂי יִתְחַמָּֽם
31.en: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

31.he: אִם הֲנִיפ֣וֹתִי עַל יָת֣וֹם יָדִ֑י כִּֽי אֶרְאֶ֥ה בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר עֶזְרָתִֽי
31.en: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,

31.he: כְּ֭תֵפִי מִשִּׁכְמָ֣ה תִפּ֑וֹל וְ֝אֶזְרֹעִ֗י מִקָּנָ֥ה תִשָּׁבֵֽר
31.en: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

31.he: כִּ֤י פַ֣חַד אֵ֭לַי אֵ֣יד אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִשְּׂאֵת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל
31.en: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

31.he: אִם שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י וְ֝לַכֶּ֗תֶם אָמַ֥רְתִּי מִבְטַחִֽי
31.en: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

31.he: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י וְכִֽי כַ֝בִּ֗יר מָצְאָ֥ה יָדִֽי
31.en: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

31.he: אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ
31.en: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

31.he: וַיִּ֣פְתְּ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לִבִּ֑י וַתִּשַּׁ֖ק יָדִ֣י לְפִֽי
31.en: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth,

31.he: גַּם ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י כִּֽי כִחַ֖שְׁתִּי לָאֵ֣ל מִמָּֽעַל
31.en: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges; for I should have denied the God who is above.

31.he: אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח בְּפִ֣יד מְשַׂנְאִ֑י וְ֝הִתְעֹרַ֗רְתִּי כִּֽי מְצָ֥אוֹ רָֽע
31.en: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

31.he: וְלֹא נָתַ֣תִּי לַחֲטֹ֣א חִכִּ֑י לִשְׁאֹ֖ל בְּאָלָ֣ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ
31.en: (yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

31.he: אִם לֹ֣א אָ֭מְרוּ מְתֵ֣י אָהֳלִ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֥ן מִ֝בְּשָׂר֗וֹ לֹ֣א נִשְׂבָּֽע
31.en: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

31.he: בַּ֭חוּץ לֹא יָלִ֣ין גֵּ֑ר דְּ֝לָתַ֗י לָאֹ֥רַח אֶפְתָּֽח
31.en: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

31.he: אִם כִּסִּ֣יתִי כְאָדָ֣ם פְּשָׁעָ֑י לִטְמ֖וֹן בְּחֻבִּ֣י עֲוֺֽנִי
31.en: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

31.he: כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱר֨וֹץ הָ֘מ֤וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וּבוּז מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת יְחִתֵּ֑נִי וָ֝אֶדֹּ֗ם לֹא אֵ֥צֵא פָֽתַח
31.en: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

31.he: מִ֤י יִתֶּן לִ֨י שֹׁ֘מֵ֤עַֽ לִ֗י הֶן תָּ֭וִי שַׁדַּ֣י יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְסֵ֥פֶר כָּ֝תַ֗ב אִ֣ישׁ רִיבִֽי
31.en: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

31.he: אִם לֹ֣א עַל שִׁ֭כְמִי אֶשָּׂאֶ֑נּוּ אֶֽעֶנְדֶ֖נּוּ עֲטָר֣וֹת לִֽי
31.en: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder; and I would bind it to me as a crown.

31.he: מִסְפַּ֣ר צְ֭עָדַי אַגִּידֶ֑נּוּ כְּמוֹ נָ֝גִ֗יד אֲקָרֲבֶֽנּוּ
31.en: I would declare to him the number of my steps. as a prince would I go near to him.

31.he: אִם עָ֭לַי אַדְמָתִ֣י תִזְעָ֑ק וְ֝יַ֗חַד תְּלָמֶ֥יהָ יִבְכָּיֽוּן
31.en: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

31.he: אִם כֹּ֭חָהּ אָכַ֣לְתִּי בְלִי כָ֑סֶף וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ בְּעָלֶ֣יהָ הִפָּֽחְתִּי
31.en: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

31.he: תַּ֤חַת חִטָּ֨ה יֵ֥צֵא ח֗וֹחַ וְתַֽחַת שְׂעֹרָ֥ה בָאְשָׁ֑ה תַּ֝֗מּוּ דִּבְרֵ֥י אִיּֽוֹב
31.en: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

32.he: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו
32.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

32.he: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים
32.en: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

32.he: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת אִיּֽוֹב
32.en: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

32.he: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים
32.en: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.

32.he: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ
32.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

32.he: וַיַּ֤עַן אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם
32.en: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

32.he: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה
32.en: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

32.he: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם
32.en: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

32.he: לֹֽא רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט
32.en: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

32.he: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי
32.en: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

32.he: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין
32.en: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

32.he: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם
32.en: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

32.he: פֶּן תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא אִֽישׁ
32.en: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

32.he: וְלֹא עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ
32.en: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

32.he: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים
32.en: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

32.he: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד
32.en: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

32.he: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף אָֽנִי
32.en: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

32.he: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי
32.en: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

32.he: הִנֵּֽה בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ
32.en: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

32.he: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה
32.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

32.he: אַל נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה
32.en: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

32.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי
32.en: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

33.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע נָ֣א אִיּ֣וֹב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה
33.en: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

33.he: הִנֵּה נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשׁוֹנִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי
33.en: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

33.he: יֹֽשֶׁר לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ
33.en: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

33.he: רֽוּחַ אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי
33.en: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

33.he: אִם תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה
33.en: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

33.he: הֵן אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם אָֽנִי
33.en: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

33.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא יִכְבָּֽד
33.en: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

33.he: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְק֖וֹל מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע
33.en: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

33.he: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֺ֣ן לִֽי
33.en: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

33.he: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאוֹת עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לֽוֹ
33.en: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

33.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל אָרְחֹתָֽי
33.en: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

33.he: הֶן זֹ֣את לֹא צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵאֱנֽוֹשׁ
33.en: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

33.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיב֑וֹתָ כִּ֥י כָל דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶֽה
33.en: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

33.he: כִּֽי בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה
33.en: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

33.he: בַּחֲל֤וֹם חֶזְי֬וֹן לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמ֗וֹת עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב
33.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed;

33.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם
33.en: Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

33.he: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה
33.en: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

33.he: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח
33.en: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

33.he: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאוֹב עַל מִשְׁכָּב֑וֹ וריבוריבוְר֖וֹבעֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן
33.en: He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

33.he: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּת֣וֹ לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה
33.en: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

33.he: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מֵרֹ֑אִי ושפיושפיוְשֻׁפּ֥וּעַ֝צְמוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ
33.en: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

33.he: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְ֝חַיָּת֗וֹ לַֽמְמִתִֽים
33.en: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

33.he: אִם יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֽוֹ
33.en: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;

33.he: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר
33.en: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

33.he: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו
33.en: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

33.he: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל אֱל֨וֹהַּ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ צִדְקָתֽוֹ
33.en: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

33.he: יָשֹׁ֤ר עַל אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי
33.en: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

33.he: פָּדָ֣ה נפשינפשינַ֭פְשׁוֹמֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת וחיתיוחיתיוְ֝חַיָּתוֹבָּא֥וֹר תִּרְאֶֽה
33.en: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

33.he: הֶן כָּל אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁל֣וֹשׁ עִם גָּֽבֶר
33.en: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

33.he: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשׁוֹ מִנִּי שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝א֗וֹר בְּא֣וֹר הַֽחַיִּים
33.en: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

33.he: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיּ֥וֹב שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר
33.en: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

33.he: אִם יֵשׁ מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ
33.en: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

33.he: אִם אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה
33.en: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

34.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר
34.en: Moreover Elihu answered,

34.he: שִׁמְע֣וּ חֲכָמִ֣ים מִלָּ֑י וְ֝יֹדְעִ֗ים הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ לִֽי
34.en: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

34.he: כִּי אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ יִטְעַ֥ם לֶאֱכֹֽל
34.en: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

34.he: מִשְׁפָּ֥ט נִבְחֲרָה לָּ֑נוּ נֵדְעָ֖ה בֵינֵ֣ינוּ מַה טּֽוֹב
34.en: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

34.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר אִיּ֣וֹב צָדַ֑קְתִּי וְ֝אֵ֗ל הֵסִ֥יר מִשְׁפָּטִֽי
34.en: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:

34.he: עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י אֲכַזֵּ֑ב אָנ֖וּשׁ חִצִּ֣י בְלִי פָֽשַׁע
34.en: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

34.he: מִי גֶ֥בֶר כְּאִיּ֑וֹב יִֽשְׁתֶּה לַּ֥עַג כַּמָּֽיִם
34.en: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

34.he: וְאָרַ֣ח לְ֭חֶבְרָה עִם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן וְ֝לָלֶ֗כֶת עִם אַנְשֵׁי רֶֽשַׁע
34.en: Who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

34.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מַר לֹ֣א יִסְכָּן גָּ֑בֶר בִּ֝רְצֹת֗וֹ עִם אֱלֹהִֽים
34.en: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

34.he: לָכֵ֤ן אַ֥נֲשֵׁ֥י לֵבָ֗ב שִׁמְע֫וּ לִ֥י חָלִ֖לָה לָאֵ֥ל מֵרֶ֗שַׁע וְשַׁדַּ֥י מֵעָֽוֶל
34.en: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

34.he: כִּ֤י פֹ֣עַל אָ֭דָם יְשַׁלֶּם ל֑וֹ וּֽכְאֹ֥רַח אִ֝֗ישׁ יַמְצִאֶֽנּוּ
34.en: For the work of a man he will render to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

34.he: אַף אָמְנָ֗ם אֵ֥ל לֹֽא יַרְשִׁ֑יעַ וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹֽא יְעַוֵּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּֽט
34.en: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

34.he: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו אָ֑רְצָה וּמִ֥י שָׂ֝֗ם תֵּבֵ֥ל כֻּלָּֽהּ
34.en: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

34.he: אִם יָשִׂ֣ים אֵלָ֣יו לִבּ֑וֹ רוּח֥וֹ וְ֝נִשְׁמָת֗וֹ אֵלָ֥יו יֶאֱסֹֽף
34.en: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

34.he: יִגְוַ֣ע כָּל בָּשָׂ֣ר יָ֑חַד וְ֝אָדָ֗ם עַל עָפָ֥ר יָשֽׁוּב
34.en: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

34.he: וְאִם בִּ֥ינָה שִׁמְעָה זֹּ֑את הַ֝אֲזִ֗ינָה לְק֣וֹל מִלָּֽי
34.en: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

34.he: הַאַ֬ף שׂוֹנֵ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יַחֲב֑וֹשׁ וְאִם צַדִּ֖יק כַּבִּ֣יר תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ
34.en: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—

34.he: הַאֲמֹ֣ר לְמֶ֣לֶךְ בְּלִיָּ֑עַל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע אֶל נְדִיבִֽים
34.en: Who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

34.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא נָשָׂ֨א פְּנֵ֥י שָׂרִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א נִכַּר שׁ֭וֹעַ לִפְנֵי דָ֑ל כִּֽי מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יָדָ֣יו כֻּלָּֽם
34.en: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor; for they all are the work of his hands.

34.he: רֶ֤גַע יָמֻתוּ֮ וַחֲצ֪וֹת לָ֥יְלָה יְגֹעֲשׁ֣וּ עָ֣ם וְיַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְיָסִ֥ירוּ אַ֝בִּ֗יר לֹ֣א בְיָֽד
34.en: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

34.he: כִּי עֵ֭ינָיו עַל דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְֽכָל צְעָדָ֥יו יִרְאֶֽה
34.en: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

34.he: אֵֽין חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וְאֵ֣ין צַלְמָ֑וֶת לְהִסָּ֥תֶר שָׁ֝֗ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
34.en: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

34.he: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א עַל אִ֭ישׁ יָשִׂ֣ים ע֑וֹד לַהֲלֹ֥ךְ אֶל אֵ֝֗ל בַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט
34.en: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

34.he: יָרֹ֣עַ כַּבִּירִ֣ים לֹא חֵ֑קֶר וַיַּעֲמֵ֖ד אֲחֵרִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם
34.en: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

34.he: לָכֵ֗ן יַ֭כִּיר מַעְבָּֽדֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥פַךְ לַ֝֗יְלָה וְיִדַּכָּֽאוּ
34.en: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

34.he: תַּֽחַת רְשָׁעִ֥ים סְפָקָ֗ם בִּמְק֥וֹם רֹאִֽים
34.en: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

34.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֵּ֭ן סָ֣רוּ מֵֽאַחֲרָ֑יו וְכָל דְּ֝רָכָ֗יו לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּֽילוּ
34.en: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

34.he: לְהָבִ֣יא עָ֭לָיו צַֽעֲקַת דָּ֑ל וְצַעֲקַ֖ת עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
34.en: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

34.he: וְה֤וּא יַשְׁקִ֨ט וּמִ֥י יַרְשִׁ֗עַ וְיַסְתֵּ֣ר פָּ֭נִים וּמִ֣י יְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ וְעַל גּ֖וֹי וְעַל אָדָ֣ם יָֽחַד
34.en: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

34.he: מִ֭מְּלֹךְ אָדָ֥ם חָנֵ֗ף מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי עָֽם
34.en: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

34.he: כִּֽי אֶל אֵ֭ל הֶאָמַ֥ר נָשָׂ֗אתִי לֹ֣א אֶחְבֹּֽל
34.en: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

34.he: בִּלְעֲדֵ֣י אֶ֭חֱזֶה אַתָּ֣ה הֹרֵ֑נִי אִֽם עָ֥וֶל פָּ֝עַ֗לְתִּי לֹ֣א אֹסִֽיף
34.en: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

34.he: הַֽמֵעִמְּךָ֬ יְשַׁלְמֶ֨נָּה כִּֽי מָאַ֗סְתָּ כִּי אַתָּ֣ה תִבְחַ֣ר וְלֹא אָ֑נִי וּֽמַה יָדַ֥עְתָּ דַבֵּֽר
34.en: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

34.he: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לֵ֭בָב יֹ֣אמְרוּ לִ֑י וְגֶ֥בֶר חָ֝כָ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֥עַֽ לִֽי
34.en: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

34.he: אִ֭יּוֹב לֹא בְדַ֣עַת יְדַבֵּ֑ר וּ֝דְבָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א בְהַשְׂכֵּֽיל
34.en: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

34.he: אָבִ֗י יִבָּחֵ֣ן אִיּ֣וֹב עַד נֶ֑צַח עַל תְּ֝שֻׁבֹ֗ת בְּאַנְשֵׁי אָֽוֶן
34.en: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

34.he: כִּ֥י יֹ֘סִ֤יף עַֽל חַטָּאת֣וֹ פֶ֭שַׁע בֵּינֵ֣ינוּ יִסְפּ֑וֹק וְיֶ֖רֶב אֲמָרָ֣יו לָאֵֽל
34.en: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

35.he: הֲ֭זֹאת חָשַׁ֣בְתָּ לְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אָ֝מַ֗רְתָּ צִדְקִ֥י מֵאֵֽל
35.en: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

35.he: כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר מַה יִּסְכָּן לָ֑ךְ מָֽה אֹ֝עִ֗יל מֵֽחַטָּאתִֽי
35.en: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

35.he: אֲ֭נִי אֲשִֽׁיבְךָ֣ מִלִּ֑ין וְֽאֶת רֵעֶ֥יךָ עִמָּֽךְ
35.en: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

35.he: הַבֵּ֣ט שָׁמַ֣יִם וּרְאֵ֑ה וְשׁ֥וּר שְׁ֝חָקִ֗ים גָּבְה֥וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ
35.en: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

35.he: אִם חָ֭טָאתָ מַה תִּפְעָל בּ֑וֹ וְרַבּ֥וּ פְ֝שָׁעֶ֗יךָ מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לּֽוֹ
35.en: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

35.he: אִם צָ֭דַקְתָּ מַה תִּתֶּן ל֑וֹ א֥וֹ מַה מִיָּדְךָ֥ יִקָּֽח
35.en: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

35.he: לְאִישׁ כָּמ֥וֹךָ רִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וּלְבֶן אָ֝דָ֗ם צִדְקָתֶֽךָ
35.en: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

35.he: מֵ֭רֹב עֲשׁוּקִ֣ים יַזְעִ֑יקוּ יְשַׁוְּע֖וּ מִזְּר֣וֹעַ רַבִּֽים
35.en: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

35.he: וְֽלֹא אָמַ֗ר אַ֭יֵּה אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֹשָׂ֑י נֹתֵ֖ן זְמִר֣וֹת בַּלָּֽיְלָה
35.en: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

35.he: מַ֭לְּפֵנוּ מִבַּהֲמ֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ וּמֵע֖וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם יְחַכְּמֵֽנוּ
35.en: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

35.he: שָׁ֣ם יִ֭צְעֲקוּ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י גְּא֣וֹן רָעִֽים
35.en: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

35.he: אַךְ שָׁ֭וְא לֹא יִשְׁמַ֥ע אֵ֑ל וְ֝שַׁדַּ֗י לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה
35.en: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

35.he: אַ֣ף כִּֽי תֹ֭אמַר לֹ֣א תְשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ דִּ֥ין לְ֝פָנָ֗יו וּתְח֥וֹלֵֽל לֽוֹ
35.en: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

35.he: וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּי אַ֭יִן פָּקַ֣ד אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא יָדַ֖ע בַּפַּ֣שׁ מְאֹֽד
35.en: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance.

35.he: וְ֭אִיּוֹב הֶ֣בֶל יִפְצֶה פִּ֑יהוּ בִּבְלִי דַ֝֗עַת מִלִּ֥ין יַכְבִּֽר
35.en: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

36.he: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר
36.en: Elihu also continued, and said,

36.he: כַּתַּר לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים
36.en: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

36.he: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן צֶֽדֶק
36.en: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

36.he: כִּֽי אָ֭מְנָם לֹא שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ
36.en: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

36.he: הֶן אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב
36.en: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

36.he: לֹא יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
36.en: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

36.he: לֹֽא יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ
36.en: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

36.he: וְאִם אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי עֹֽנִי
36.en: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

36.he: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ
36.en: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

36.he: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן
36.en: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

36.he: אִֽם יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים
36.en: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

36.he: וְאִם לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי דָֽעַת
36.en: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

36.he: וְֽחַנְפֵי לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם
36.en: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

36.he: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים
36.en: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

36.he: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם
36.en: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

36.he: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ מִפִּי צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן
36.en: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

36.he: וְדִין רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ
36.en: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

36.he: כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה פֶּן יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל יַטֶּֽךָּ
36.en: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

36.he: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי כֹֽחַ
36.en: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

36.he: אַל תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם
36.en: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

36.he: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי עַל זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי
36.en: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

36.he: הֶן אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה
36.en: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

36.he: מִֽי פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה
36.en: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness?’

36.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים
36.en: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

36.he: כָּל אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק
36.en: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

36.he: הֶן אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא חֵֽקֶר
36.en: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

36.he: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ
36.en: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

36.he: אֲשֶֽׁר יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י אָדָ֬ם רָֽב
36.en: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

36.he: אַ֣ף אִם יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּתֽוֹ
36.en: Yes, can any understand the spreading of the clouds, and the thunderings of his pavilion?

36.he: הֵן פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה
36.en: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

36.he: כִּי בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר
36.en: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

36.he: עַל כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ
36.en: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

36.he: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל עוֹלֶֽה
36.en: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also concerning the storm that comes up.

37.he: אַף לְ֭זֹאת יֶחֱרַ֣ד לִבִּ֑י וְ֝יִתַּ֗ר מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ
37.en: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

37.he: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּרֹ֣גֶז קֹל֑וֹ וְ֝הֶ֗גֶה מִפִּ֥יו יֵצֵֽא
37.en: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

37.he: תַּֽחַת כָּל הַשָּׁמַ֥יִם יִשְׁרֵ֑הוּ וְ֝אוֹר֗וֹ עַל כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ
37.en: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

37.he: אַחֲרָ֤יו יִשְׁאַג ק֗וֹל יַ֭רְעֵם בְּק֣וֹל גְּאוֹנ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יְ֝עַקְּבֵ֗ם כִּֽי יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹלֽוֹ
37.en: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

37.he: יַרְעֵ֤ם אֵ֣ל בְּ֭קוֹלוֹ נִפְלָא֑וֹת עֹשֶׂ֥ה גְ֝דֹל֗וֹת וְלֹ֣א נֵדָֽע
37.en: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

37.he: כִּ֤י לַשֶּׁ֨לַג יֹאמַ֗ר הֱוֵ֫א אָ֥רֶץ וְגֶ֥שֶׁם מָטָ֑ר וְ֝גֶ֗שֶׁם מִטְר֥וֹת עֻזּֽוֹ
37.en: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

37.he: בְּיַד כָּל אָדָ֥ם יַחְתּ֑וֹם לָ֝דַ֗עַת כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֥י מַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ
37.en: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

37.he: וַתָּבֹ֣א חַיָּ֣ה בְמוֹ אָ֑רֶב וּבִמְע֖וֹנֹתֶ֣יהָ תִשְׁכֹּֽן
37.en: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

37.he: מִן הַ֭חֶדֶר תָּב֣וֹא סוּפָ֑ה וּֽמִמְּזָרִ֥ים קָרָֽה
37.en: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

37.he: מִנִּשְׁמַת אֵ֥ל יִתֶּן קָ֑רַח וְרֹ֖חַב מַ֣יִם בְּמוּצָֽק
37.en: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

37.he: אַף בְּ֭רִי יַטְרִ֣יחַ עָ֑ב יָ֝פִ֗יץ עֲנַ֣ן אוֹרֽוֹ
37.en: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

37.he: וְה֤וּא מְסִבּ֨וֹת מִתְהַפֵּ֣ךְ בתחבולתובתחבולתובְּתַחְבּוּלֹתָ֣יולְפָעֳלָ֑ם כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצַוֵּ֓ם עַל פְּנֵ֖י תֵבֵ֣ל אָֽרְצָה
37.en: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

37.he: אִם לְשֵׁ֥בֶט אִם לְאַרְצ֑וֹ אִם לְ֝חֶ֗סֶד יַמְצִאֵֽהוּ
37.en: Whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

37.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה זֹּ֣את אִיּ֑וֹב עֲ֝מֹ֗ד וְהִתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן נִפְלְא֬וֹת אֵֽל
37.en: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

37.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע בְּשׂוּם אֱל֣וֹהַּ עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝הוֹפִ֗יעַ א֣וֹר עֲנָנֽוֹ
37.en: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

37.he: הֲ֭תֵדַע עַל מִפְלְשֵׂי עָ֑ב מִ֝פְלְא֗וֹת תְּמִ֣ים דֵּעִֽים
37.en: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

37.he: אֲשֶׁר בְּגָדֶ֥יךָ חַמִּ֑ים בְּהַשְׁקִ֥ט אֶ֝֗רֶץ מִדָּרֽוֹם
37.en: You whose clothing is warm, when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

37.he: תַּרְקִ֣יעַ עִ֭מּוֹ לִשְׁחָקִ֑ים חֲ֝זָקִ֗ים כִּרְאִ֥י מוּצָֽק
37.en: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

37.he: ה֭וֹדִיעֵנוּ מַה נֹּ֣אמַר ל֑וֹ לֹ֥א נַ֝עֲרֹ֗ךְ מִפְּנֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
37.en: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

37.he: הַֽיְסֻפַּר ל֭וֹ כִּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר אִֽם אָ֥מַר אִ֝֗ישׁ כִּ֣י יְבֻלָּֽע
37.en: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

37.he: וְעַתָּ֤ה לֹ֘א רָ֤אוּ א֗וֹר בָּהִ֣יר ה֭וּא בַּשְּׁחָקִ֑ים וְר֥וּחַ עָ֝בְרָ֗ה וַֽתְּטַהֲרֵֽם
37.en: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

37.he: מִ֭צָּפוֹן זָהָ֣ב יֶֽאֱתֶ֑ה עַל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נ֣וֹרָא הֽוֹד
37.en: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

37.he: שַׁדַּ֣י לֹֽא מְ֭צָאנֻהוּ שַׂגִּיא כֹ֑חַ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וְרֹב צְ֝דָקָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽה
37.en: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

37.he: לָ֭כֵן יְרֵא֣וּהוּ אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לֹֽא יִ֝רְאֶ֗ה כָּל חַכְמֵי לֵֽב
37.en: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

38.he: וַיַּֽעַן יְהוָ֣ה אֶת אִ֭יּוֹב מנ הסערהמנ הסערהמִ֥ן הַסְּעָרָ֗הוַיֹּאמַֽר
38.en: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

38.he: מִ֤י זֶ֨ה מַחְשִׁ֖יךְ עֵצָ֥ה בְמִלִּ֗ין בְּֽלִי דָֽעַת
38.en: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

38.he: אֱזָר נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ וְ֝אֶשְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי
38.en: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

38.he: אֵיפֹ֣ה הָ֭יִיתָ בְּיָסְדִי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ בִינָֽה
38.en: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

38.he: מִי שָׂ֣ם מְ֭מַדֶּיהָ כִּ֣י תֵדָ֑ע א֤וֹ מִֽי נָטָ֖ה עָלֶ֣יהָ קָּֽו
38.en: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

38.he: עַל מָ֭ה אֲדָנֶ֣יהָ הָטְבָּ֑עוּ א֥וֹ מִֽי יָ֝רָ֗ה אֶ֣בֶן פִּנָּתָֽהּ
38.en: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

38.he: בְּרָן יַ֭חַד כּ֣וֹכְבֵי בֹ֑קֶר וַ֝יָּרִ֗יעוּ כָּל בְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
38.en: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

38.he: וַיָּ֣סֶךְ בִּדְלָתַ֣יִם יָ֑ם בְּ֝גִיח֗וֹ מֵרֶ֥חֶם יֵצֵֽא
38.en: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

38.he: בְּשׂוּמִ֣י עָנָ֣ן לְבֻשׁ֑וֹ וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל חֲתֻלָּתֽוֹ
38.en: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

38.he: וָאֶשְׁבֹּ֣ר עָלָ֣יו חֻקִּ֑י וָֽ֝אָשִׂ֗ים בְּרִ֣יחַ וּדְלָתָֽיִם
38.en: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

38.he: וָאֹמַ֗ר עַד פֹּ֣ה תָ֭בוֹא וְלֹ֣א תֹסִ֑יף וּפֹ֥א יָ֝שִׁ֗ית בִּגְא֥וֹן גַּלֶּֽיךָ
38.en: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here?’

38.he: הְֽ֭מִיָּמֶיךָ צִוִּ֣יתָ בֹּ֑קֶר ידעתה שחרידעתה שחריִדַּ֖עְתָּה הַשַּׁ֣חַרמְקֹמֽוֹ
38.en: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

38.he: לֶ֭אֱחֹז בְּכַנְפ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִנָּעֲר֖וּ רְשָׁ עִ֣יםמִמֶּֽנָּה
38.en: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

38.he: תִּ֭תְהַפֵּךְ כְּחֹ֣מֶר חוֹתָ֑ם וְ֝יִֽתְיַצְּב֗וּ כְּמ֣וֹ לְבֽוּשׁ
38.en: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

38.he: וְיִמָּנַ֣ע מֵרְשָׁ עִ֣יםאוֹרָ֑ם וּזְר֥וֹעַ רָ֝מָ֗ה תִּשָּׁבֵֽר
38.en: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

38.he: הֲ֭בָאתָ עַד נִבְכֵי יָ֑ם וּבְחֵ֥קֶר תְּ֝ה֗וֹם הִתְהַלָּֽכְתָּ
38.en: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

38.he: הֲנִגְל֣וּ לְ֭ךָ שַׁעֲרֵי מָ֑וֶת וְשַׁעֲרֵ֖י צַלְמָ֣וֶת תִּרְאֶֽה
38.en: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

38.he: הִ֭תְבֹּנַנְתָּ עַד רַחֲבֵי אָ֑רֶץ הַ֝גֵּ֗ד אִם יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ
38.en: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

38.he: אֵי זֶ֣ה הַ֭דֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁכָּן א֑וֹר וְ֝חֹ֗שֶׁךְ אֵי זֶ֥ה מְקֹמֽוֹ
38.en: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

38.he: כִּ֣י תִ֭קָּחֶנּוּ אֶל גְּבוּל֑וֹ וְכִֽי תָ֝בִ֗ין נְתִיב֥וֹת בֵּיתֽוֹ
38.en: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

38.he: יָ֭דַעְתָּ כִּי אָ֣ז תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וּמִסְפַּ֖ר יָמֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים
38.en: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

38.he: הֲ֭בָאתָ אֶל אֹצְר֣וֹת שָׁ֑לֶג וְאֹצְר֖וֹת בָּרָ֣ד תִּרְאֶֽה
